A characteristic-two counterexample to dévissage for local deformation functors. Complete negative answer to the unrestricted fibre-product question using the additive F4 action and F2 subgroup; excludes every prorepresentable recipient. Prorepresentable-component variant unaddressed; nilpotent constant coordinate changes permitted. Known action, involution conjugacy and recipient collapse (Byszewski-Cornelissen2009 Props4.1/6.1) credited. Bounded priority, no exhaustive novelty guarantee. Extensive AI use; unrefereed; AI adversarial reviews, no conventional human peer review. Proof and verification: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1024
